<documents>
<document id="travel-emergency-card">
EmergencyˆcardˆwhileˆabroadˆIfˆyou'reˆaˆPremiumˆmemberˆandˆyourˆcardˆisˆlost,ˆstolenˆorˆdamagedˆwhileˆyou'reˆoutsideˆtheˆUS,ˆweˆcanˆsendˆanˆemergencyˆcardˆtoˆwhereˆyou'reˆstaying.ˆItˆarrivesˆwithinˆ3ˆbusinessˆdaysˆandˆcostsˆ$0.00.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆrequestˆoneˆ1.ˆFreezeˆorˆreportˆyourˆcardˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ2.ˆMessageˆsupportˆandˆaskˆforˆanˆemergencyˆcard.ˆ3.ˆGiveˆtheˆfullˆaddressˆwhereˆyou'llˆbeˆforˆtheˆnextˆfewˆdays,ˆsuchˆasˆaˆhotel.ˆDeliveryˆcanˆtakeˆlongerˆinˆremoteˆareas.ˆTheˆcardˆisˆactivatedˆinˆtheˆappˆlikeˆanyˆotherˆcard.ˆ##ˆBasicˆandˆPlusˆmembersˆEmergencyˆcardsˆabroadˆaren'tˆavailableˆonˆBasicˆorˆPlus.ˆStandardˆandˆexpeditedˆshippingˆonlyˆgoˆtoˆUSˆaddresses.ˆInstead,ˆaddˆaˆvirtualˆcardˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆuseˆitˆinˆyourˆphone'sˆwalletˆwhileˆyou'reˆaway.ˆYourˆreplacementˆcanˆbeˆsentˆtoˆyourˆUSˆaddress.ˆ##ˆCashˆabroadˆVirtualˆcardsˆcan'tˆbeˆusedˆatˆATMs.ˆIfˆyouˆneedˆcash,ˆyouˆcanˆaskˆsomeoneˆwithˆaˆTallowbrookˆaccountˆtoˆsendˆyouˆmoneyˆbyˆBrookPayˆandˆthenˆuseˆaˆcard-freeˆoptionˆatˆyourˆdestination,ˆorˆrelyˆonˆcardˆpaymentsˆinˆstores.ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
<document id="card-virtual">
VirtualˆcardsˆEveryˆverifiedˆmemberˆcanˆcreateˆoneˆvirtualˆcardˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆItˆworksˆrightˆawayˆforˆonlineˆpurchasesˆandˆinˆmobileˆwallets,ˆsoˆyouˆcanˆkeepˆspendingˆwhileˆaˆphysicalˆcardˆisˆonˆitsˆway.ˆ##ˆCreateˆaˆvirtualˆcardˆTapˆCards,ˆthenˆAddˆvirtualˆcard.ˆTheˆcardˆnumber,ˆexpiryˆdateˆandˆsecurityˆcodeˆareˆshownˆinˆtheˆappˆafterˆyouˆconfirmˆit'sˆyou.ˆ##ˆHowˆit'sˆdifferentˆfromˆyourˆphysicalˆcardˆ-ˆItˆhasˆitsˆownˆcardˆnumber.ˆ-ˆItˆhasˆitsˆownˆfreezeˆswitch.ˆFreezingˆyourˆphysicalˆcardˆdoesn'tˆfreezeˆtheˆvirtualˆone.ˆ-ˆItˆcan'tˆbeˆusedˆatˆATMs.ˆ-ˆReportingˆyourˆphysicalˆcardˆlostˆorˆstolenˆdoesn'tˆcancelˆtheˆvirtualˆcard.ˆ##ˆReplacingˆaˆvirtualˆcardˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆtheˆvirtualˆcardˆnumberˆhasˆbeenˆexposed,ˆdeleteˆitˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆcreateˆaˆnewˆone.ˆThere'sˆnoˆfee.ˆRememberˆtoˆupdateˆanyˆmerchantsˆthatˆstoredˆtheˆoldˆnumber.ˆLimitsˆandˆfeesˆareˆtheˆsameˆasˆforˆyourˆphysicalˆcard,ˆandˆvirtualˆcardˆspendingˆcountsˆtowardˆtheˆsameˆdailyˆcardˆspendingˆlimit.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="card-lost-stolen-v2">
LostˆorˆstolenˆcardˆIfˆyourˆcardˆisˆlostˆorˆstolen,ˆyouˆcanˆdealˆwithˆitˆinˆtheˆappˆinˆaˆcoupleˆofˆminutes.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtoˆcallˆus.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆ1.ˆ**Freezeˆtheˆcard.**ˆTapˆCardsˆandˆswitchˆFreezeˆcardˆon.ˆThisˆstopsˆnewˆpurchasesˆrightˆaway.ˆ2.ˆ**Reportˆit.**ˆIfˆyouˆcan'tˆfindˆit,ˆtapˆReportˆlostˆorˆstolen.ˆThisˆcancelsˆtheˆcardˆpermanently.ˆItˆcan'tˆbeˆundone.ˆ3.ˆ**Addˆaˆvirtualˆcard.**ˆYouˆcanˆcreateˆoneˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆuseˆitˆonlineˆandˆinˆmobileˆwalletsˆrightˆawayˆwhileˆtheˆreplacementˆships.ˆ4.ˆ**Orderˆaˆreplacement.**ˆPickˆstandardˆorˆexpeditedˆshipping.ˆReplacementˆandˆshippingˆfeesˆdependˆonˆyourˆplan.ˆ5.ˆ**Checkˆyourˆtransactions.**ˆDisputeˆanythingˆyouˆdon'tˆrecognize.ˆ##ˆDeliveryˆStandardˆshippingˆtakesˆ7ˆtoˆ10ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆtakesˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆUnauthorizedˆtransactionsˆYou'reˆnotˆresponsibleˆforˆunauthorizedˆcardˆtransactionsˆyouˆreportˆwithinˆ60ˆdaysˆofˆtheˆstatementˆtheyˆfirstˆappearˆon.ˆIfˆyouˆfoundˆyourˆcardˆafterˆfreezingˆit,ˆjustˆunfreezeˆit.ˆNothingˆelseˆchanges.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: Can I get a virtual card while I'm waiting on my replacement?
